name: QuotesDemo
summary: This EA is a utility that fetches and displays Google Finance quotes (world indices, currencies, or bonds) via WebRequest in a custom dialog panel on the chart. It periodically updates the quotes every 10 seconds using a timer and does not place any trades.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个工具类程序，通过WebRequest从Google Finance获取并显示世界指数、货币或债券报价于图表上的自定义对话框面板中。它每10秒通过定时器更新报价，不进行任何交易操作。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个报价展示工具。其核心功能是通过WebRequest函数从Google Finance网页抓取金融报价数据，包括世界指数、货币和债券三大类别。入场条件不适用，因为该EA不执行任何交易操作。出场条件同样不适用，没有持仓管理逻辑。仓位管理不适用，没有开仓或平仓的代码。资金管理不适用，该EA仅负责数据获取与UI展示，完全没有任何涉及资金管理的模块。定时器每10秒触发一次更新，通过GetTickCount进行节流控制防止过于频繁的请求。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a quote display utility. Its core function is to fetch financial quote data from Google Finance via the WebRequest function, covering three categories: world indices, currencies, and bonds. Entry conditions are not applicable since this EA does not execute any trading operations. Exit conditions are similarly not applicable as there is no position management logic. Position sizing is not applicable since there is no code for opening or closing positions. Money management is not applicable as the EA only handles data retrieval and UI display with absolutely no money management module. The timer triggers updates every 10 seconds with GetTickCount-based throttling to prevent excessively frequent requests.

parameters.name: TableIndex
parameters.description: Google Finance报价表选择：世界指数、货币或债券
parameters.description_en: Google Finance quote table: world indices, currencies or bonds

pros: 使用WebRequest实现实时外部数据获取，功能实用
提供三大金融类别的报价切换，覆盖面较广
自定义对话框UI展示，用户体验友好
pros_en: Implements real-time external data fetching via WebRequest, providing practical functionality
Offers quote switching across three major financial categories with broad coverage
Custom dialog UI display provides a user-friendly experience
cons: 依赖Google Finance网页结构，网页改版即可导致功能失效
无错误恢复机制，WebRequest失败后仅返回false无重试逻辑
缺少代理和HTTPS证书处理，网络环境适应性差
cons_en: Depends on Google Finance web page structure which may break upon site redesign
No error recovery mechanism; WebRequest failure simply returns false without retry logic
Lacks proxy and HTTPS certificate handling, resulting in poor network environment adaptability
improvements: 增加WebRequest失败后的自动重试机制与指数退避策略
改用结构化API替代网页抓取，提高数据可靠性
improvements_en: Add automatic retry mechanism with exponential backoff after WebRequest failure
Replace web scraping with a structured API for improved data reliability

risk_points: 不执行任何交易操作，无交易风险
WebRequest超时设置仅5秒，慢网络下可能频繁失败
risk_points_en: Does not execute any trading operations, no trading risk
WebRequest timeout is only 5 seconds which may cause frequent failures on slow networks

summary_en: This EA is a utility that fetches and displays Google Finance quotes (world indices, currencies, or bonds) via WebRequest in a custom dialog panel on the chart. It periodically updates the quotes every 10 seconds using a timer and does not place any trades.
